description: Find England planning dataset entities intersecting a bounded WGS84 box around a point, including conservation areas, listed buildings, Article 4 directions and flood risk zones. Dataset OGL terms are checked and attribution retained. Coverage may be incomplete; this is not a planning determination. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

dataset.description: Dataset identifier from the allowed values in this schema.

lat.description: Confirmed WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees; pair with lon.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

lon.description: Confirmed WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees; pair with lat.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres; spatial tools use a bounding box around the point.

name: planning_entities
